attchmntText: AKASH: Akash Infra Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication of Financial Results for quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Akash Infra Projects Limited filed a newspaper advertisement regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company approved these un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results on November 6, 2026. Zeal Aqua Limited also approved its unaudited financial results for the same period on November 5, 2026. Purohit Construction Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results on November 6, 2026. Crescent Finstock Limited filed its extract of standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Akash Infra Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
